name: media
need: Show files, photos or recordings as thumbnails in a grid that can be opened, selected and acted on

--ds-media-min.description: the narrowest column of `.ds-media-grid` at md, 32px more or less per size step

--ds-media-gap.description: the gap of `.ds-media-grid` at the comfortable density, 4px less per density step

--ds-media-ratio.description: the picture of a media card (`--square` 1 / 1, `--wide` 16 / 9)

--ds-media-selected-bg.description: a selected media card's fill (its checkbox checked)

labExempt.DS.media.between: a pure function of a list: no motion
labExempt.DS.media.create: focus, keys and checkboxes: the selection's colours change on --ds-dur-fast like any selected card, nothing moves

ripple..ds-media__open: the open control is a line of text whose stretched ::after is the card's hit area and state layer; a ripple host clips to its own box, which would cut the ripple to the title
